title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1979-09-04
source: Nakamichi 700s > Sony TC-158, 14th row recording by Barry Glassberg. Transferred MAC > CDR by Jim Wise (c2000) CDR > EAC > TLH > FLAC 1644 tagged (Dec 2011)

ai_review.summary: Well‑recorded front‑of‑board capture of an average, somewhat boring setlist.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its clear front‑of‑board sound and perfect ambient balance, requiring no EQ tweaks. The performance itself is viewed as merely average – a few enjoyable moments like the He's Gone jam and Wharf Rat are noted, but overall the setlist feels unexciting. Reviewers are split between a very negative take on the song selection and an appreciative note on the tape quality.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is judged average/boring while recording quality is rated good; weighted combination yields a middle‑range rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Front‑of‑board (FOB) capture praised for clear ambient sound and balanced mix; reviewer notes it needs no EQ adjustments, though another upload is described as brighter.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Overall set considered boring and average, despite a few strong moments in the second set.
